name: ECC Orchestrator
description: Surfaces openclaw-ecc-orchestrator runtime events (runs, attention, approvals, merges) and records approval decisions made in OpenClaw.

eventLog.description: Absolute path of the runtime's openclaw-events.jsonl (read only).

inbox.description: Absolute path of the runtime's decision inbox directory.

stateDir.description: Absolute directory for the plugin's read position and view state (outside ~/.openclaw).

runtimeCli.description: Optional absolute path of the runtime CLI executable, used only for read only 'status' calls.

runtimeCliArgs.description: Optional arguments placed before 'status --json', for example ['-m', 'openclaw_ecc_orchestrator', '--config', '/abs/config.json'].

pollIntervalMs.description: Event log poll interval in milliseconds (default 1000).

configSchema.description: eventLog, inbox and stateDir are required for the plugin to run; without them it registers only a /ecc command that explains the missing configuration.
